summary: feat(auth): finish device disconnects when pruning capped sessions
description:
Because:
- limitSessions deletes device rows in SQL, leaving their refresh tokens
  live and never telling attached services the device is gone.

This commit:
- Calls limitSessions_4 and returns the devices it deleted.
- Moves device refresh-token revocation into a shared helper.
- Revokes those refresh tokens and sends device:delete from prune-tokens.
- Lets notifyAttachedServices take a callback for when SNS publish settles.

Closes FXA-14945
